analysis_cirs.ac:
* Auto-generated SPICE netlist - Push Pull DC-DC Converter
* Auto-grounded net 1 due to VIN:-
* Created internal net n11 for RSN_Q1:neg -> CSN_Q1:pos
* Created internal net n12 for RSN_Q2:neg -> CSN_Q2:pos
* Created internal net n13 for RSN_SEC:neg -> CSN_SEC:pos
.options rshunt=1e+12 cshunt=1e-12 reltol=0.01 abstol=1e-09 vntol=1e-05 chgtol=1e-11 gmin=1e-10
.options method=gear maxord=2 trtol=4
.model nmos_model NMOS(Vto=3 Lambda=0.01 Kp=0 Cbd=1n Cbs=1n Cgdo=100p Is=1e-14 Tt=100n Rs=0.01)
.model Dmodel D(Is=1e-12 n=1.1 Rs=0.1 Cjo=1e-11 Tt=0 Bv=100 Ibv=1e-06)
* --- Common-Core Coupled Inductor Model (Robust) ---
* NOTE: Default params are placeholders - always pass actual values from YAML
.subckt Xdualctfmr P1 CT_P P2 S1 CT_S S2 Lm_primary=100u Ns=1 K=0.99 Rp1=0.05 Rp2=0.05 Rs1=0.05 Rs2=0.05
* --- PRIMARY WINDINGS ---
* Center-tapped primary: P1->CT and P2->CT ensure correct Push-Pull phasing
Rp1_res P1 P1_int {Rp1}
Lp1 P1_int CT_P {Lm_primary/4}
Rp2_res P2 P2_int {Rp2}
Lp2 CT_P P2_int {Lm_primary/4}
* --- SECONDARY WINDINGS ---
Rs1_res S1 S1_int {Rs1}
Ls1 S1_int CT_S {Lm_primary*Ns*Ns/4}
Rs2_res S2 S2_int {Rs2}
Ls2 CT_S S2_int {Lm_primary*Ns*Ns/4}
* --- COUPLING ---
* Kall couples all inductors with coupling coefficient from YAML
K1 Lp1 Lp2 {K}
K2 Lp1 Ls1 {K}
K3 Lp1 Ls2 {K}
K4 Lp2 Ls1 {K}
K5 Lp2 Ls2 {K}
K6 Ls1 Ls2 {K}
* --- DAMPING (Crucial for convergence) ---
* Damping resistors provide safe path for leakage during switching dead-time
Rdamp1 P1_int CT_P 1k
Rdamp2 P2_int CT_P 1k
Rdamp3 S1_int CT_S 1k
Rdamp4 S2_int CT_S 1k
.ends Xdualctfmr

VIN VIN_src 0 DC 12
RVIN_series VIN_src n0 0.01
VC1_SENSE n0 n_C1_sense 0
LC1_ESL n_C1_sense n_C1_esl 1e-10
RC1_ESR n_C1_esl n_C1_esr 0.05
C1 n_C1_esr 0 0.0001
RC1_LEAK n0 0 5e+06
VQ1_SENSE n2 n_Q1_dsense 0
MQ1 n_Q1_dsense n4 0 0 nmos_model
VQ2_SENSE n3 n_Q2_dsense 0
MQ2 n_Q2_dsense n5 0 0 nmos_model
VT1_SENSE_PRI1 n2 n_T1_p1_sense 0
VT1_SENSE_PRI2 n3 n_T1_p2_sense 0
VT1_SENSE_SEC1 n6 n_T1_s1_sense 0
VT1_SENSE_SEC2 n7 n_T1_s2_sense 0
XT1 n_T1_p1_sense n0 n_T1_p2_sense n_T1_s1_sense n10 n_T1_s2_sense Xdualctfmr Lm_primary=0.0001 Ns=1 K=0.9 Rp1=0.05 Rp2=0.05 Rs1=0.05 Rs2=0.05
RSN_Q1 n2 n11 20
CSN_Q1 n11 0 1e-09
RSN_Q2 n3 n12 20
CSN_Q2 n12 0 1e-09
RSN_SEC n8 n13 20
CSN_SEC n13 n10 1e-09
R_ISO n10 0 1e+08
VD1_SENSE n6 n_D1_sense 0
RD1_SENSE_DAMP n_D1_sense n_D1_damp 0.001
D1 n_D1_damp n8 Dmodel
VD2_SENSE n7 n_D2_sense 0
RD2_SENSE_DAMP n_D2_sense n_D2_damp 0.001
D2 n_D2_damp n8 Dmodel
VL1_SENSE n8 n_L1_sense 0
RL1_ESR n_L1_sense n_L1_ser 0.1
L1 n_L1_ser n9 4.7e-05
CL1_par n8 n9 5e-11
RL1_core n8 n9 1e+06
VC0_SENSE n9 n_C0_sense 0
LC0_ESL n_C0_sense n_C0_esl 1e-10
RC0_ESR n_C0_esl n_C0_esr 0.05
C0 n_C0_esr n10 4.7e-05
RC0_LEAK n9 n10 4e+06
VRLOAD_SENSE n9 n_RLOAD_sense 0
LRLOAD_PL n_RLOAD_sense n_RLOAD_mid 1e-08
RLOAD n_RLOAD_mid n10 100
VPWM1 n_PWM1_int 0 PULSE(0 12 0 1e-07 1e-07 3.9e-06 1e-05)
RPWM1_drive n_PWM1_int n4 100
VPWM2 n_PWM2_int 0 PULSE(0 12 5e-06 1e-07 1e-07 3.9e-06 1e-05)
RPWM2_drive n_PWM2_int n5 100

.end

.control
set noaskquit
set nomoremode
set numdgt=9

.endc

* Transient Requirement tr_startup: Startup transient from 0V to 12V output. Push-pull converter is NON-INVERTING (output positive terminal [RLOAD, pos] referenced to isolated ground [T1, CT_S]). Measure VOUT at [RLOAD, pos]. Verify output reaches target voltage with acceptable overshoot and settling time.
tran 1e-07 0.015 0 1e-06 uic
linearize
let vout_peak_diff = v(n9) - v(n10)
meas tran vout_peak max vout_peak_diff from=0.012 to=0.015
print vout_peak
let vout_final_diff = v(n9) - v(n10)
meas tran vout_final avg vout_final_diff from=0.012 to=0.015
print vout_final
let VOUT_diff = v(n9) - v(n10)
meas tran t_settle TRIG AT=0.0 TARG VOUT_diff VAL=11.399999999999999 CROSS=LAST
print t_settle
let VIN = v(n0)
wrdata time_series/tr_startup_VIN.csv v(n0)
let VOUT_csv_diff = v(n9) - v(n10)
let VOUT = VOUT_csv_diff
wrdata time_series/tr_startup_VOUT.csv VOUT_csv_diff
let v_C1_auto = v(n0)
wrdata time_series/V_C1.csv v_C1_auto
wrdata time_series/I_C1.csv i(VC1_SENSE)
let v_Q1_auto = v(n2)
wrdata time_series/V_Q1.csv v_Q1_auto
wrdata time_series/I_Q1.csv i(VQ1_SENSE)
let v_Q1_gate_auto = v(n4)
wrdata time_series/Gate_Q1.csv v_Q1_gate_auto
let v_Q2_auto = v(n3)
wrdata time_series/V_Q2.csv v_Q2_auto
wrdata time_series/I_Q2.csv i(VQ2_SENSE)
let v_Q2_gate_auto = v(n5)
wrdata time_series/Gate_Q2.csv v_Q2_gate_auto
let v_T1_auto = v(n2) - v(n3)
wrdata time_series/V_T1.csv v_T1_auto
wrdata time_series/I_T1_pri.csv i(VT1_SENSE_PRI1)
wrdata time_series/I_T1_sec.csv i(VT1_SENSE_SEC1)
wrdata time_series/I_T1.csv i(VT1_SENSE_PRI1)
let v_D1_auto = v(n6) - v(n8)
wrdata time_series/V_D1.csv v_D1_auto
wrdata time_series/I_D1.csv i(VD1_SENSE)
let v_D2_auto = v(n7) - v(n8)
wrdata time_series/V_D2.csv v_D2_auto
wrdata time_series/I_D2.csv i(VD2_SENSE)
let v_L1_auto = v(n8) - v(n9)
wrdata time_series/V_L1.csv v_L1_auto
wrdata time_series/I_L1.csv i(VL1_SENSE)
let v_C0_auto = v(n9) - v(n10)
wrdata time_series/V_C0.csv v_C0_auto
wrdata time_series/I_C0.csv i(VC0_SENSE)
let v_RLOAD_auto = v(n9) - v(n10)
wrdata time_series/V_RLOAD.csv v_RLOAD_auto
wrdata time_series/I_RLOAD.csv i(VRLOAD_SENSE)
wrdata time_series/Gate_PWM1.csv v(n4)
wrdata time_series/Gate_PWM2.csv v(n5)
plot v(n0) title 'tr_startup_VIN'
plot VOUT_csv_diff title 'tr_startup_VOUT'

plot i(VC1_SENSE) title 'I_C1'
plot v_Q1_auto title 'V_Q1'
plot i(VQ1_SENSE) title 'I_Q1'
plot v_Q1_gate_auto title 'Gate_Q1'
plot v_Q2_auto title 'V_Q2'
plot i(VQ2_SENSE) title 'I_Q2'
plot v_Q2_gate_auto title 'Gate_Q2'
plot v_T1_auto title 'V_T1'
plot i(VT1_SENSE_PRI1) title 'I_T1_pri'
plot i(VT1_SENSE_SEC1) title 'I_T1_sec'
plot i(VT1_SENSE_PRI1) title 'I_T1'
plot v_D1_auto title 'V_D1'
plot i(VD1_SENSE) title 'I_D1'
plot v_D2_auto title 'V_D2'
plot i(VD2_SENSE) title 'I_D2'
plot v_L1_auto title 'V_L1'
plot i(VL1_SENSE) title 'I_L1'
plot v_C0_auto title 'V_C0'
plot i(VC0_SENSE) title 'I_C0'
plot v_RLOAD_auto title 'V_RLOAD'
plot i(VRLOAD_SENSE) title 'I_RLOAD'
plot v(n4) title 'Gate_PWM1'
plot v(n5) title 'Gate_PWM2'

* Transient Requirement tr_regulation: Steady-state output voltage regulation at nominal load. Measure VOUT at [RLOAD, pos] after startup transient settles. Verify output voltage is within regulation tolerance.
tran 1e-07 0.015 0 1e-06 uic
linearize
let vout_avg_diff = v(n9) - v(n10)
meas tran vout_avg avg vout_avg_diff from=0.012 to=0.015
print vout_avg

* Transient Requirement tr_output_ripple: Output voltage ripple at steady state. Measure peak-to-peak ripple voltage at [RLOAD, pos] during steady-state operation (after startup settling). Verify ripple is within acceptable limits.
tran 1e-07 0.015 0 1e-06 uic
linearize
let vout_ripple_pp_diff = v(n9) - v(n10)
meas tran vout_ripple_pp pp vout_ripple_pp_diff from=0.012 to=0.015
print vout_ripple_pp
let vout_avg_ripple_diff = v(n9) - v(n10)
meas tran vout_avg_ripple avg vout_avg_ripple_diff from=0.012 to=0.015
print vout_avg_ripple
let VOUT_RIPPLE_csv_diff = v(n9) - v(n10)
let VOUT_RIPPLE = VOUT_RIPPLE_csv_diff
wrdata time_series/tr_output_ripple_VOUT_RIPPLE.csv VOUT_RIPPLE_csv_diff

plot v(n5) title 'Gate_PWM2'

* Transient Requirement tr_switch_stress: Primary switch voltage and current stress. Measure peak drain-source voltage across Q1 and Q2, and peak drain current through Q1 and Q2. Verify switches operate within safe limits (no excessive voltage spikes or current overshoot).
tran 1e-07 0.015 0 1e-06 uic
linearize
meas tran vds_q1_max max v(n2) from=0.012 to=0.015
print vds_q1_max
meas tran vds_q2_max max v(n3) from=0.012 to=0.015
print vds_q2_max
meas tran id_q1_max max i(vq1_sense) from=0.012 to=0.015
print id_q1_max
meas tran id_q2_max max i(vq2_sense) from=0.012 to=0.015
print id_q2_max
wrdata time_series/tr_switch_stress_ID_Q1.csv i(vq1_sense)
wrdata time_series/tr_switch_stress_ID_Q2.csv i(vq2_sense)
let VDS_Q1 = v(n2)
wrdata time_series/tr_switch_stress_VDS_Q1.csv v(n2)
let VDS_Q2 = v(n3)
wrdata time_series/tr_switch_stress_VDS_Q2.csv v(n3)
wrdata time_series/Gate_PWM1.csv v(n4)
wrdata time_series/Gate_PWM2.csv v(n5)
plot i(vq1_sense) title 'tr_switch_stress_ID_Q1'
plot i(vq2_sense) title 'tr_switch_stress_ID_Q2'
plot v(n2) title 'tr_switch_stress_VDS_Q1'
plot v(n3) title 'tr_switch_stress_VDS_Q2'
plot v(n4) title 'Gate_PWM1'
plot v(n5) title 'Gate_PWM2'

* Transient Requirement tr_transformer_current: Transformer primary and secondary current waveforms. Measure primary current (through Q1/Q2 drains) and secondary current (through D1/D2 anodes). Verify balanced operation and no DC bias buildup in transformer.
tran 1e-07 0.015 0 1e-06 uic
linearize
meas tran ipri_max max i(vt1_sense_pri1) from=0.012 to=0.015
print ipri_max
meas tran ipri_avg avg i(vt1_sense_pri1) from=0.012 to=0.015
print ipri_avg

.model nmos_model NMOS(Vto=3 Lambda=0.01 Kp=0 Cbd=1n Cbs=1n Cgdo=100p Is=1e-14 Tt=100n Rs=0.01)

* --- PRIMARY WINDINGS ---

Lp1 P1_int CT_P {Lm_primary/4}

Lp2 CT_P P2_int {Lm_primary/4}

Ls2 CT_S S2_int {Lm_primary*Ns*Ns/4}

K2 Lp1 Ls1 {K}
K3 Lp1 Ls2 {K}
K4 Lp2 Ls1 {K}
